forWhat: The first page you see. It shows your lessons for a day and what to prepare, then your tasks.
Your tasks sit on a board by how soon they are due. Each card has its own button.

layout.shows: The day you are looking at. [[Previous day]] and [[Next day]] move it, and [[Pick a day]] jumps to any date.
Your lessons for that day, in order, in their subject colours. Choose one to see what to prepare: what it is for, the steps and the rubric.

A filter row (Subject, Class and What), then a board of cards in four columns: Do now, This week, When ready and Done. Cards such as [[Topics to mark as taught]], [[Answers to check]] and [[Parent reports to approve]] sit in the column for when they are due.
A card or lesson you choose opens here, with its own button. [[Open full page]] opens it on a page of its own. Close it with the cross or Escape.
A folded note of what the school's answers say this week.

jobs.title: Start your day
steps: Open My day from the menu.
Look at your lessons first. Choose one to see what to prepare.
Then look at My tasks. Start with the column Do now. Press the button on a card to do that one job.

jobs.title: Say a topic was taught
steps: Choose the card [[Topics to mark as taught]].
Press [[Mark as taught]] beside the topic. If it is taught in more than one of your classes, choose the class first.
The topic is now taught for that class alone. Its skills can go on that class's papers.

buttons.label: Pick a day
buttons.does: Shows your lessons and tasks for the day you choose.
buttons.doesNot: It changes nothing in the timetable.

buttons.label: Mark as taught
buttons.does: Records the topic as taught for that one class, in your name.
